Traceability.recipeTargetsIntro: An exact value, a range, or both. The unit comes from the variable and is not typed.

Traceability.plotAttributesIntro: Everything is optional. What you leave blank stays “Not recorded”, which is not the same as zero. The area in hectares is what makes density and yield per hectare computable.

Traceability.correctionIntro: The original reading ({variable}: {value} {unit}) is NOT deleted: it stays in the record marked as superseded. This creates a new reading that supersedes it.
Traceability.correctionOccurredAtLabel: When the correct reading was taken
Traceability.correctionReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I wrote 24 and the instrument read 42
Traceability.biocharIntro: Every burn, documented with the Table 6 fields from the research framework. Without thermal regime, feedstock and charging recorded, “10 t/ha of biochar” describes a volume, not a treatment.
Traceability.biocharCodeHelp: The link between the material, the plot and every later measurement. Without it, results cannot be attributed.
Traceability.biocharProducedAtHelp: Where the kiln is, which is not where it will be applied. A batch is burned once and may be applied across several plots.
Traceability.biocharProducedOnHelp: Aging is derived from this: fresh char and weathered char behave differently.
Traceability.biocharFeedstockHelp: Type and proportions if mixed. It is the single largest determinant of final properties.
Traceability.biocharPeakTempHelp: Above 750 °C the sum of the 16 US EPA PAHs rises compared with the 450–600 °C range. It is recorded either way: the reading is the reading.
Traceability.biocharTempMethodHelp: A 550 from a thermocouple and a 550 estimated from flame colour are not the same claim.
Traceability.biocharOxygenHelp: How air was restricted, and how flame and smoke behaved. It is the variable separating pyrolysis from combustion.
Traceability.biocharStorageHelp: Where and how the material waited between burning and use.
Traceability.biocharChargingIntro: Determines whether the material acts as a nutrient carrier or a nutrient sink: uncharged biochar can adsorb soil nitrogen at first.
Traceability.biocharLabHelp: Which one only. The analysis results cannot be recorded here yet.
Traceability.biocharAgingUnknown: No production date, so this cannot be computed
Traceability.error_biochar: Could not save the biochar batch: {detail}
Traceability.biocharCharacterisationIntro: The Table 7 parameters. Without them the batch is documented but not characterised, and “10 t/ha” still describes a volume, not a treatment.
Traceability.biocharNoMeasurements: No analyses recorded for this batch yet.
Traceability.biocharUnitHelp: Filled with the parameter's canonical unit and editable: if the report comes in %, type % and the system converts.
Traceability.biocharSourceRefHelp: The laboratory report's number or name, so the paper can be found again.
Traceability.soilProfileIntro: The soil profile description. It needs no laboratory, and it is the only thing that tells a wet, well-structured soil — an asset — from a wet, compacted one, which is a ceiling no fertiliser programme lifts.
Traceability.soilNoProfiles: No soil pit described for this plot yet.
Traceability.soilPitDepthHelp: The framework asks for 80–100 cm where terrain allows. If rock stopped it earlier, record what was reached: that says something too.
Traceability.soilRootingDepthHelp: The single most important number for root health in this soil. Coffee fine roots concentrate near the surface, so a shallow constraint does disproportionate damage.
Traceability.soilAnaerobicIntro: The signs that the soil periodically runs out of air. Each has three answers, and “not recorded” is a fourth: “not looked for” and “looked for and absent” are not the same.
Traceability.soilImpedingDepthHelp: How deep the layer that blocks roots or water appears, if any. It is the number that decides whether the problem is drainage or nutrition.
Traceability.soilHorizonsIntro: From the surface downwards. Rows left blank are discarded.
Traceability.error_soil_profile: Could not save the soil pit: {detail}
Traceability.samplesIntro: The sample and the result are two different things: a sample leaves weeks before a number comes back, so first record that it was collected and then what the laboratory said.
Traceability.sampleTreatmentPlotHelp: Free text for now: the trial layout (T0–T4) is Step 8 and sampling happens before it.
Traceability.sampleSamplingPointHelp: The point's tag, so next year's round returns to the same place. Without it, a soil-chemistry series compares different spots and calls it change.
Traceability.sampleDepthHelp: The framework asks for roughly 0–20, 20–40 and 40–60. Two depths are never mixed in one sample.
Traceability.sampleSubSamplesHelp: 10–15 taken across the plot at the same depth, mixed. Never across treatments or depths.
Traceability.sampleExtractionHelp: Phosphorus is highly method-dependent: a Bray P and a Mehlich P do not compare.
Traceability.sampleProtocolIntro: Without this, year-to-year comparison means nothing: treatment differences are swamped by sampling noise.
Traceability.sampleLeafPairHelp: Counting down from the tip. The exact number is agreed with the laboratory and then never changed.
Traceability.samplePhenologyHelp: The usual reference timing is pre-flowering.
Traceability.sampleBearingLabel: The sampled branch was bearing fruit

Traceability.error_proceso_seleccion_bajo_proceso_abi: This coffee has an open process: selection is done before opening it or after closing it, and green grading after closing it; a process is closed with its closing moisture.
Traceability.error_proceso_fusion_bajo_proceso_abiert: Coffee that has an open process is not combined with other coffee: not merged, not blended, and not in a split with several inputs.
Traceability.error_proceso_receta_distinta_del_proces: The run's recipe is the lot process's recipe.
Traceability.error_proceso_lineage_too_deep: This lot's lineage is deeper than the system walks (64 generations). It has to be reviewed by hand.
Traceability.error_proceso_motivo_otro_requiere_nota: With “other”, write the reason in the note.
Traceability.error_proceso_process_already_open: There is already an open process in this coffee (in this lot, above or below it).
Traceability.error_proceso_devolucion_antes_del_cierr: Going back to drying cannot be recorded now: the process closing or the lot's entry into storage is dated later than this moment. Tell whoever manages the platform.
Traceability.error_proceso_descendiente_en_bodega: Part of this coffee is already in storage, and stored coffee is not reprocessed: on this lot you cannot open a process or send it back to drying. To process what is left, split the lot first; if what is stored has a moisture defect, send the lot that is in storage back to drying.
Traceability.error_proceso_corrida_ya_abierta: This lot already has an open fermentation or drying, and a run consumes its whole lot. End that run: the next one starts on the lot that comes out of it.
Traceability.error_proceso_lote_consumido: This lot has already gone, whole, into another one: the run or transformation that consumed it has ended. The next run starts on the lot that came out of it.
Traceability.error_proceso_medicion_anterior_al_proce: That moisture was measured before this process started, so it does not say how it ended. Close the process with a reading taken since it started.
Traceability.error_proceso_drying_not_finished: The process that covers this lot is still open: the lot does not go into storage until the process is closed with its closing moisture at target, on “Lot process”.
Traceability.error_proceso_moisture_above_target: The process that covers this lot was closed above its target moisture, and the lot does not go into storage. Send it back to drying: “Back to drying”, on “Lot process”.
Traceability.error_proceso_no_closing_moisture: The process that covers this lot was closed without a closing moisture, so it is unknown whether it reached its target, and the lot does not go into storage. Tell whoever manages the platform.
Traceability.error_proceso_process_already_closed: This process is already closed, and a closed process is not changed. Reload the page to see how it ended; if the lot has a moisture defect, use “Back to drying”.

Beneficio.limitacionesPrefijo: What this verdict could NOT look at:
Beneficio.umbralesProvisionales: Provisional thresholds from general practice: you have not validated them against your equipment yet. This suggests; you decide.
Beneficio.sinVeredicto_SIN_PROCESO_ABIERTO: No open process: there is no phase to judge.
Beneficio.sinVeredicto_SIN_GRADO_DECLARADO: The process does not state its grade, so there are no thresholds to apply.
Beneficio.sinVeredicto_GRADO_SIN_PERFIL: This process grade has no thresholds written yet. The washed ones are not lent to it: they belong to another kinetics.
Beneficio.sinVeredicto_SIN_LECTURAS: No readings in this phase yet. Record one and it will show up here.
Beneficio.limitacion_SIN_PUNTO_DE_MUESTREO: where each sample was taken (tank liquor and mucilage are not comparable)
Beneficio.limitacion_UN_SOLO_PUNTO_DE_CAMA: whether the bed dries evenly — that needs three points
Beneficio.limitacion_SIN_ACTIVIDAD_DE_AGUA: water activity, which governs whether it keeps in storage
Beneficio.estado_SENSOR_FAULT: reading outside the measurable range — check the instrument
Beneficio.estado_SUSPECT_DILUTION: suspicious reading: could be rinse water or the electrode out of the liquid
Beneficio.estado_STALLED_ROT_HAZARD: pH is not falling — risk of rot. Worth checking the tank temperature before deciding: a cold tank slows the microflora, and that looks like an infection without being one.
Beneficio.estado_STALL_SUSPENDED_COLD_HOLD: cold hold: the plateau is expected
Beneficio.estado_KINETIC_PLATEAU: the curve has not moved for hours, even though the value is in range
Beneficio.estado_MIXED_SAMPLE_POINTS: the series mixes sample points and they are not comparable
Beneficio.estado_DATA_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION: °Bx rose with no recorded cause — check the prism
Beneficio.estado_RATE_TOO_FAST: falling too fast for this phase — risk of sealing the surface. Worth checking the exposure and comparing the reading against the weight: a sealed bean makes the meter read low and false, and the mould shows up in storage weeks later.
Beneficio.estado_STALLED_MOLD_HAZARD: not falling, above 20 % — risk of mould. Worth checking the turning and the airflow through the bed: above 20 % the bean has not left the range where mould thrives.
Beneficio.limitacion_SIN_INSTRUMENTO_DECLARADO: None of these readings says which instrument produced it, so whether it was checked could not be verified.
Beneficio.estado_REVISION_VENCIDA: The instrument passed its reference check, but longer ago than expected. It can still be used; a fresh check is advisable.
Beneficio.limitacion_UMBRAL_SIN_VARIETAL: the resting threshold is the process's, not this varietal's (a Geisha may need more)
Beneficio.limitacion_SIN_FIN_DE_SECADO: drying has not been closed, so the resting clock has not started
Beneficio.limitacion_SECADO_SIN_OBJETIVO_ALCANZADO: drying was closed without declaring it reached target moisture
Beneficio.limitacion_PERFIL_SIN_REPOSO: this profile declares no resting thresholds
Beneficio.reposoSinDias: no resting days: the clock has not started
Beneficio.compuerta_TEMPRANA: early — allowed, and recorded as such

Secado.ambienteIntro: Record the air in this place: temperature, relative humidity, sky and ventilation. Relative humidity is the AIR's, not the grain's: grain moisture is measured in a bed inspection. Each reading only counts for the spot where it was taken — level 2 says nothing about level 5 — and it always shows how long ago it was taken. Drying is a shared environment: when one lot falls behind, act on the lot first (move the tray, fan); changing the room affects every lot inside it.
